title: Resurrection protocol
steps: Confirm power to UNIT-01, then its network.
Agent quiet but machine up: it restarts the agent itself; wait for the pulse.
Machine unreachable: power-cycle it (manual), then let services return on boot.
Rerun any missed daily jobs; each is idempotent and never double-publishes.
Verify the channels, then confirm with a test message.
note: What was missed and where each backup lives is in the keeper's private runbook.
